text.p: The following are top stories from selected Singapore newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Singapore government will give school fee subsidies to low-income families in Before and After School Care programmes.
- Singapore Senior Minister Lee Kuan Yew says Singapore's growth rate can bounce back to 7.5-8 percent next year.
- Singapore Straits Times Industrials Index goes up 43 points from institutional buying.
- City Developments and Republic Hotels & Resorts makes top Singapore $55.5 million bid for Fullerton Square.
- Initial Public Offering's fever drives FJ Benjamin's share price up to a high of S$1.35 for 68.8 percent premium over its 80 cent offer price.
- Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index achieved its first ever close above 13,000 on Thursday.
- Aztech Systems says estimates of its potential liability for copyright infringement are baseless.
- Sembawang Corp clinches two Cairnhill sites for S$116.4 million.
- Goodwood Park Hotel posts a 15.5 percent rise in net profit to S$36.42 million for year ended September 30.
- Singapore Telecom shares up on speculation Morgan Stanley Capital International will announce a higher weighting for stock in its Singapore indices.
- Hitachi Zosen Singapore Ltd clinches an order for four dry cargo/container carriers at a cost of about Singapore $100 million.
- European rating agency IBCA is assigning individual ratings for rist time to United Overseas Bank, Keppel Bank and Tat Lee Bank.
